profile.headline: Software Engineer at Inside Real Estate

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on the web team, created and led the initiative for performance and code quality

- Overhauled the method of displaying hundreds of listings, increasing Google PageSpeed
Insights score by over 40 points, leading to higher conversion rates and 65% increase in
user engagement within the first month
- Increased user engagement
- Implemented cancel tokens for stale network requests, reducing network traffic by over
2GB per week
- Continually finding ways to refactor the code base to be cleaner and more maintainable

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Valued engineer on the Porch team

- Developed training material for junior engineers, greatly improving the onboarding
process
- Wrote custom components and mixins to reduce repetitive code
- Implemented new design patterns, improving functionality and user experience
- Worked on experimental tooling in an effort to improve developer experience
- Coordinate with management, project managers and QA to find solutions to technical
challenges
- Worked with a highly focused team, maintaining a high level of responsibility and strict
deadlines

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Primary developer responsible for maintaining the FPS GOLD banking application.

- Responsible for keeping Angular and dependencies up to date
- Developing new features to meet customer needs
- Developing interfaces to integrate with third party vendors, greatly expanding our market of potential customers
- Refactoring legacy code to work with new features
- Wrote and maintain a program that allows customers to migrate their existing wire templates to our product, greatly easing the conversion process.
- Work with potential clients regarding and implementing feature requests to ensure our platform meets their needs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Fulfilled contract work for several large companies
including: Alpine Australia, Bloomberg, CueScript,
Frontline International, and Renesas.

- Lead the design and development of implementing UI concepts.
- Worked closely with graphics designer and hardware engineer to implement and add new features.
- Used web technologies to interface with hardware devices.
- Used advanced techniques to allow UI and hardware interactions to run on separate threads. And implemented an API to allow communication between the two processes.
- Researched and experimented with different technologies for upcoming products.
- Rapidly iterated on new features to find problems and prove concepts.
- Worked closely with hardware engineers to implement an API that was easy to use and could process raw packet data from a device.
- Developed an attractive UI concept for displaying real-time IoT data.
- Developed a prototype mobile app that demonstrated the ability to control a physical device by expanding the existing API.
- Wrote and generated API documentation.
- Executed the development of a new web based application that allows users to operate hardware remotely.
- Worked closely with back-end engineers to implement an API for procedurally generating UI elements.
- Implemented new features and bug fixes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Increased productivity of staff members by consolidating their workflow into a single application. Provided training to developers less familiar with the technology. Worked with in-demand technologies and APIs

positions.title: Computer Technician and Consultant
positions.description: Offered a variety of technology related services to clients

positions.description: Communicated with clients under direction of supervisor to build websites as part of a dynamic team
